data.description: The figure is a BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) graphical report for well ID Forge 56-32, located in the UTAHFORGE field. The BHA consists of various components including HWDP (Heavy Weight Drill Pipe), JAR (Jointed Assembly Ring), DC (Drill Collar), RR (Reduction Ring), STAB (Stabilizer), and BIT (Bit). Each component is detailed with its length, internal diameter, external diameter, top thread type, serial number, and the distance from the top to the bit. The report also includes the date of insertion and removal, as well as the depth at which these operations occurred.
